title: cheirostylis gymnochiloides
intro: Cheirostylis gymnochiloides, commonly known as the Green Orchid, is a species of orchid found in the tropical regions of Asia. It is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. The health benefits of Cheirostylis gymnochiloides include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and digestive issues.
